sections.content: AI-agent infrastructure dominates today's GitHub momentum, while practical local AI and creative AI form the second major signal.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Coding-agent infrastructure, security agent workflows, local inference, knowledge and research agents, and creative AI. Listed primary-language counts: TypeScript 3; Go 2; Python 2; JavaScript 2; C, Swift, Rust, and Java 1 each.

sections.title: Notable Shifts
sections.content: GitHub momentum is moving from individual AI applications toward agent operating infrastructure: skills, audit protocols, research loops, and code-review systems, alongside a push for local and efficient inference.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: The hottest activity is concentrated in the layer around AI models: agents that execute work, skills that constrain and verify them, and runtimes that make inference cheaper or local. Security, knowledge management, voice, and music show the pattern spreading beyond software engineering.
